exceptions.reason: CVE-2026-93687: stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. No patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected). braces reaches us only through build tooling (sass -> chokidar, stylelint -> micromatch) that expands this repository's own glob patterns; it is never shipped. Even stylelint 17.16.0 still depends on it.
